parameters.content:
## Insight Synthesis Engine
Turns interview transcripts plus blog, web and note text into themes, each with an insight and the exact quotes behind it.

**To use it:** open the form at /form/insight-engine, paste your material, press Analyse and wait on the page. You never need to edit a node.

**Pattern:** every stage ends in a check. If a check fails, the form shows a plain message and the run stops.

Needs a Groq credential (free tier works). Advanced limits are in Run Inputs. Tested on small samples, not at scale.

## 1 Load the sources
Turns the form into a list of sources. If nothing was given, the form shows a plain message and the run stops here. Web links are downloaded and reduced to their paragraph text.

## 2 Anonymise and chunk
Names you list, emails and phone numbers are replaced BEFORE any AI call. Text is cut into short pieces, taken in turn from each source so no source dominates, up to the token budget. If no usable text is left, the run stops with a plain message.

## 3 Find the themes
One AI call reads a sample of the text and proposes a few themes. If it fails, the run stops with a plain message instead of wasting calls.

## 4 Place every chunk in a theme
Chunks go to the AI in small batches with a pause between calls (Groq free tier: 8,000 tokens per minute). An unreadable answer leaves its chunks unassigned and flagged.

## 5 Write the insights and show the report
One AI call per theme returns an insight and piece ids only. The quotes are copied from your text by code, so they are never reworded. The report opens on the form page, with warnings, flags and cards for Miro or FigJam.
